# Brightwater Facilities Group -- Order Form

This Order Form records the terms on which Brightwater Facilities Group provides facilities management and workplace services to Halvard Systems. It is synthetic material generated for NorthForge evaluation; Brightwater Facilities Group, Halvard Systems, and every person named below are fictional.

## Term and Renewal

This Order Form takes effect on 2026-01-26 and the current term expires on 2027-01-26. Renewal is automatic for a further twelve (12) month term unless either party gives thirty (30) days written notice that it does not wish to renew. Brightwater Facilities Group shall acknowledge a non-renewal notice in writing.

## Payment Terms

Payment terms. Halvard Systems shall pay each undisputed Brightwater Facilities Group invoice within ninety (90) days. Invoices must reference the applicable order form, and interest of one and a half percent (1.5%) per month applies to late undisputed amounts.

## Limitation of Liability

Except for the carve-outs below, the aggregate liability of each party arising out of this Order Form is limited to the fees paid by Halvard Systems to Brightwater Facilities Group in the three (3) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Liability for breach of confidentiality and for a breach of data protection obligations is not capped by this clause.

## Notices

Any notice, including notice of non-renewal or termination, must be in writing and sent to contracts@brightwater.example.com or contracts@halvard.example.com as applicable. Notices sent to any other address are not effective under this Order Form.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Priya Raghavan, Procurement Lead. Signed for Brightwater Facilities Group by Ines Calloway, Chief Revenue Officer. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
